title: Nordwell Research: EU EV battery recycling revenue reached EUR 1.9 billion in 2025
text: Nordwell Research today published its EU EV Battery Recycling Outlook (doc_id: nordwell-eu-outlook-2026). The report sizes the EU-27 market for recycling lithium-ion batteries from electric vehicles at EUR 1.9 billion in 2025, measured as revenue of collection, pre-treatment and hydrometallurgical processing services. It does not count the resale value of recovered metals. Nordwell expects revenue to grow at a compound annual rate of 21% from 2025 to 2030, driven mostly by gigafactory production scrap until end-of-life packs arrive in volume after 2030. Full methodology is in the report.
